market.what: cement grinding aids and strength enhancers (alkanolamine-based), world
market.method: 3.8 Gt cement x ~50% treated x ~350 g/t = ~670 kt x ~$1.5/kg (est.) = ~$1.0B; reports say $5.3B (looks inflated)

value.logic: 5 pts less clinker at same 1-2 d strength: 5% x ($50 clinker - $15 SCM)/t = $1.75/t + CO2 0.04 t/t x ~$70 in EU; on ~1.5 Gt adopting = ~$3B/yr (est.)
value.revenue_logic: 20 Mt cement/yr treated x 400 g/t x ~$3/kg = ~$24M (direct or via admixture partner)
value.margin_logic: alkanolamine from ethyleneamine + EO, cheap inputs; price set by clinker savings

trend.drivers: clinker factor cuts (LC3, slag, limestone); EU CBAM + ETS free-allowance phase-out from 2026
trend.deadline: EU CBAM definitive period from 1 Jan 2026

competition.paper_query: low clinker cement early strength admixture
competition.notes: Sika and Saint-Gobain dominate after 2022-25 M&A; C-S-H seeding is the incumbent early-strength fix

lab.synth: catalog or 1-step custom (hydroxyethyl/hydroxypropyl ethyleneamines), 3 variants x 100 g
lab.test: EN 196-1 mortar strength 1/2/7/28 d + isothermal calorimetry (ASTM C1702) + set time EN 196-3 in LC3/CEM II blends at a university cement lab
lab.logic: synth 4 wk + 6 wk tests (28 d cure); synth $5k + tests ~$12k (est.)

sale.gates: ASTM C465 processing-addition test ~6 mo; EN 197-1 additive limits; plant mill trial + 28/90 d data 1 yr
